history.summary: Identity and location CONFIRMED: the Kaleshwar Shiva Temple is in the village of Kaleswar (Mayureswar-II block), Birbhum district, West Bengal, on State Highway 11. It is widely described as the tallest Shiva temple of West Bengal, its main tower about 109-110 feet tall. Antiquity and patronage are not documented by any source found - treat the temple's age as unverified. Not to be confused with the Kalyaneshwar/Kaleshwar Mandir at Bally, Howrah, nor the Kaleshwaram temples of Telangana.

name: Kaleshwar Shiva Temple
town_description: Kaleswar is a village in the Mayureswar-II block of Birbhum district, West Bengal, on State Highway 11, with the pin code area 731213/731218. Its Shiva temple, said to be the tallest Shiva temple in West Bengal at ~109 feet, is the village's main landmark and a regional pilgrimage draw, especially on Maha Shivratri.
